scenario.description: A couple is enjoying a getaway together.

agent_a.name: Ethan

profile.personality_and_values: Ethan Johnson, a creative yet somewhat reserved individual, values power and fairness. He likes to analyse situations before deciding.
profile.public_info: Ethan Johnson is famous for cooking Italian food.

agent_a.goal: Share bed and sleep together (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been sharing the bed for a few nights but the other person is not sleeping well</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Ethan wants to share the bed so that he can maintain a sense of fairness and intimacy in their relationship.

agent_b.name: Esmeralda

profile.personality_and_values: Esmeralda Solis, known for her creativity and extraversion, values authority and liberty. She makes strategic, decisive decisions.
profile.public_info: Esmeralda Solis is an accomplished District Attorney who has a weakness for ballroom dancing and enjoys practising in her leisure time.

agent_b.goal: Sleep in a separate bed to get a good night's sleep but also maintain the intimacy with your partner (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been experiencing back pain and needs a firmer mattress to sleep on.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Esmeralda wants to sleep in a separate bed because she needs a firmer mattress to alleviate her back pain.
